ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Streaming would be a useful addition to my TV setup, provided my TV has a compatible HDMI input.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in practical accessories than adding a voice-controlled speaker right now.
ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My tablet already serves my portable screen needs, and I have no current need for a smart display.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need a dedicated screen for Alexa or video calling.
ItemID: 5; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I often buy connection accessories, and the extra length could help connect equipment around my TV.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My car purchases focus on mounting and connecting devices; I have no clear need for Alexa in the car.

ItemID: 8; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My camera accessory purchases do not establish a current need for a home monitoring camera.
ItemID: 9; Title: SanDisk 32GB 2-Pack Ultra MicroSDHC UHS-I Memory Card (2x32GB) - SDSQUAR-032G-GN6MT; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I repeatedly use smaller memory cards, and this pair fits my habit of keeping storage available for multiple devices.
ItemID: 10; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Heather Gray; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A different color does not change my lack of a current need for a smart speaker.
